stem: ![](asset:P000338-stem-1)Masses of 1 kg and 3 kg hang from threads attached to the two ends of a uniform rod of mass 6 kg lying on a smooth table, as shown in the figure. Find the tension in the rod at the section X shown in the figure.

assets.alt: A 6 kg bar of length L on a horizontal table, joined by strings over pulleys at both ends of the table to hanging masses: 1 kg on the left (tension T₁) and 3 kg on the right (tension T₂). A section X is marked L/4 from the bar's left end.
